verdict.summary: Round 2 remains sound and honest on the diff-scoped evidence. The fixed-width ladder iterates over the scalar field modulus width, performs a doubling and addition on every bit, and arithmetically selects either the affine base or the Edwards identity; its focused differential tests cover zero, maximal/high-bit, randomized scalars, and a non-generator base against the prior arkworks implementation. The production call-site test independently pins public-key and nonce-commitment equality and verifies the resulting signature. The audit documentation consistently limits the claim to removal of scalar-dependent control-flow shape, explicitly preserves the not-asserted-constant-time posture for arkworks field operations, notes the lack of instrumented timing evidence, and retains the research-grade/external-audit caveat. No hostile reviewer-directed instruction was detected. Findings are unchanged from round 1 (none), so progress is stagnant under the required scale.
